name: TypeScript Quality Check
description: Runs TypeScript compilation, ESLint, and Prettier checks after code edits
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Run TypeScript + ESLint + Prettier on edited file
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(ts|tsx)$ ]]; then
  npx tsc --noEmit 2>/dev/null
  npx eslint --fix "$FILE" 2>/dev/null
  npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null
fi
exit 0
